allow: Bash git commands (git add / git commit / git push) whose diff touches only this repository's own agent-instruction files (CLAUDE.md, .claude/rules/*.md) are allowed, PROVIDED the same commit also carries a line in docs/journal/<week>.md saying what changed and why. Owner decision 2026-09-16: the permission and the journal entry are one thing, not two — an instruction file that changes without a trace is the class that already cost this project 16 days of a missing invariant (ADR-344) and 6 days of a missing deployment rule. Enforced mechanically, not by this sentence: scripts/check_rules_change_is_journalled.py + the pre-commit hook that calls it.
